explanation: Goodman's conjecture: for a p-valent f on the disc with f(0) = 0 and n > p, |b_n| ≤ Σ_{k=1}^p 2k(n+p)!/((p−k)!(p+k)!(n−p−1)!(n²−k²))·|b_k|. The bound matches Wikipedia's formula. p-valence is counted at distinct points, which the docstring justifies as equivalent for non-constant analytic f. The test checks the p = 1 reduction to n|b₁|. The statement is faithful and open.
